INTEGRATED SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory Safety.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory Safety.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory Safety.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory Safety.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Reproductive System? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Human Reproductive System.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproductive System.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Reproductive System.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Reproductive System.

8. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Magnetism? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Magnetism.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Magnetism.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Magnetism.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Magnetism.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Acids, Bases and Indicators? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Acids, Bases and Indicators.

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System.

14. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory apparatus and instruments? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory apparatus and instruments.

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Human Excretory System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Magnetism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Integrated Science and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Laboratory Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
